propositions: Interrupted ticket directory creation leaves behind empty stray directories that fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH because os.makedirs runs outside the write lock and precedes the first event file write by several steps
Directory and first event file must be published atomically via a single os.rename operation on a complete staging directory to eliminate the vulnerable window between mkdir and event write

Staging directories use dot-prefixed naming convention (.tmp-newticket-*) to leverage existing fsck scanner exclusion rules, making temporary paths invisible to both MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH checks without scanner changes

Both single-event and batch event creation paths inherit the interrupted-write vulnerability through the shared _prepare_event function and must be converted to use the same StagedEvent staging-and-promote mechanism

Stale staging directories from dead processes must be swept (bounded, best-effort, only .tmp-newticket-* paths) at writer start without violating the 043f policy that tolerates event-less ticket directories and never cleans committed store data
